question: What is the average forecasted annual sales for products 4160 and 7790 during 2018, using monthly sales data starting from January 2016 for the first 36 months, applying seasonality adjustments from time steps 7 through 30, and employing a weighted regression method to estimate sales?
sql:
WITH data AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS time_step
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        time_step,
        AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 6 FOLLOWING) AS cma1,
        AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS cma2
    FROM data
),
cma_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        time_step,
        (cma1 + cma2) / 2.0 AS cma
    FROM cma_calc
    WHERE time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        time_step,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(mth AS DATE)) AS month_of_year,
        qty,
        cma,
        qty / cma AS sales_to_cma_ratio
    FROM cma_avg
),
seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_of_year,
        AVG(sales_to_cma_ratio) AS seasonal_index
    FROM ratios
    GROUP BY product_id, month_of_year
),
normalized_seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_of_year,
        seasonal_index,
        seasonal_index / NULLIF(AVG(seasonal_index) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id), 0) AS norm_index
    FROM seasonality
),
deseasonalized AS (
    SELECT 
        d.product_id,
        d.time_step,
        CASE WHEN ns.norm_index > 0 THEN d.qty / ns.norm_index ELSE NULL END AS deseasonalized_qty
    FROM data d
    JOIN normalized_seasonality ns ON d.product_id = ns.product_id AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(d.mth AS DATE)) = ns.month_of_year
    WHERE d.time_step <= 36
),
weighted_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        SUM(time_step) AS sum_wx,
        SUM(deseasonalized_qty) AS sum_wy,
        SUM(time_step * time_step) AS sum_wx2,
        SUM(time_step * deseasonalized_qty) AS sum_wxy,
        COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM deseasonalized
    WHERE deseasonalized_qty IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY product_id
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        (sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy / n) / (sum_wx2 - sum_wx * sum_wx / n) AS slope,
        (sum_wy - (sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy / n) / (sum_wx2 - sum_wx * sum_wx / n) * sum_wx) / n AS intercept
    FROM weighted_stats
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        r.product_id,
        time_step,
        r.slope * time_step + r.intercept AS trend_value
    FROM regression r
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(37, 48)) AS time_step) t
),
forecast_with_seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        f.product_id,
        f.time_step,
        f.trend_value,
        ns.norm_index,
        f.trend_value * ns.norm_index AS forecast_qty
    FROM forecast f
    JOIN normalized_seasonality ns ON f.product_id = ns.product_id 
        AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM DATE_ADD(DATE '2016-01-01', INTERVAL (f.time_step - 1) MONTH)) = ns.month_of_year
),
annual_forecasts AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        SUM(forecast_qty) AS annual_forecast
    FROM forecast_with_seasonality
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(annual_forecast) AS average_forecasted_annual_sales
FROM annual_forecasts
